versions.text: If there is a device to lock the flight controls (a) Not applicable in this subpart (see USAR.1825 Flight control system lock warning) (b) There must be a means to (1) Warn the ground staff when the device is engaged; (2) Not applicable. versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction
versions.title_at_revision: Primary or secondary flight controls lock
versions.text:
If there is a device to lock the flight controls:
(a) Not applicable in this subpart. (see USAR.U1825 Flight control system lock warning)
(b) There must be a means to:
  (1) Warn the ground staff when the device is engaged;
  (2) Not applicable.
(c) The device must have a means to preclude the possibility of it becoming inadvertently engaged in flight.
